description_sq:

title_en: Rruga Qemal Stafa, Tirana, Apartment For Sale 3+1+verand!
description_en: Apartment 3+1 near the Red School. The apartment is located on the seventh floor, the newly completed new building. The apartment has a surface of 142 m2 and a veranda of 62 m2. The apartment has good natural lighting and the products used in the construction of the building are contemporary and of high quality.
